Create a single self-contained HTML file using HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and dat.gui.

Requirements:
- Use one 800×800 <canvas> centered on a dark background.
- Allowed external library: dat.gui for parameter controls.
- No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets.
- Everything must be inside a single HTML file.

Color style:
- Use this exact neon palette:
  - Background: #05070f
  - Background glow: #101a3a
  - Main branch color: #00e5ff
  - Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
  - Synapse color: #ff2bd6
  - Pulse color: #fff36a
  - UI/accent color: #ffd400
  - Optional dark grid/scanline color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)
- The final look should be futuristic, high contrast, glowing, and slightly gritty.
- Use canvas shadowBlur for neon glow effects.
- Do not use images or textures.
- Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in the generated code or comments.

GUI:
- Add a dat.gui control panel.
- Organize controls into folders:
  - Growth
  - Synapses
  - Pulses
  - Visuals

  - branch growth speed
  - max branch depth
  - branch split chance
  - branch curvature
  - max branch length
  - synapse distance threshold
  - synapse glow strength
  - pulse speed
  - pulse frequency
  - pulse brightness
  - background color
  - branch color
  - accent branch color
  - synapse color
  - pulse color
- Add buttons:
  - regenerate network
  - clear canvas
  - pause/resume animation

params: neuronCount 3-6 (default 5), growthSpeed 0.5-5 (2), maxDepth 1-8 (5), splitChance 0-0.2 (0.04), curvature 0-1 (0.35), maxBranchLength 20-200 (90 steps... segment points), synapseDistance 4-40 (14), synapseGlow 0-40 (18), pulseSpeed 0.005-0.08 (0.02), pulseFrequency 0-1 (0.3 pulses spawn prob per frame), pulseBrightness 0.2-2 (1), colors bg, branch, accent, synapse, pulse. Buttons: regenerate, clear, pauseResume (toggle label via controller.name). Folders Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals, all open.

Data: neurons [{x,y}], branches [{neuron, points:[{x,y}], angle, depth, width (0.6-1.6 random, thinner with depth), maxLen, growing, accent (random 20%), parentIdx}]. MAX_BRANCHES=400. Seeds 3-6 (neuronCount) within 80px of center; each spawns 3-5 branches at spread angles.

Growth: per frame, accumulate growthSpeed steps; each growing branch step: angle += (rand-0.5)*curvature*0.6 ; step length 3; add point; stop if out of bounds margin 20, length>=maxLen*(1-depth*0.1). Split with splitChance if depth<maxDepth and count<MAX -> child branch at angle±(0.4..0.9), shorter maxLen*0.6. On end, if depth<maxDepth, 50% fork into 2. When no growing branches, growth done ("stable").

Synapse detection: for each growing tip, check other branches' tips of different neurons (or non-parent) — compare tip against points of other branches sampled every 3rd point, within synapseDistance; key `min-max` of branch indices in a Set to prevent duplicates; synapse {a,b, x,y, ai: point index in a, bi: point index in b, phase}. Cap 150.

Pulses: build adjacency map of neurons via synapses. Spawn pulse: pick random synapse; pulse travels along branch a from root (index 0) to ai, then along branch b from bi back to 0 (a path list of points). Pulse {path, t 0..1, speed}. Interpolate position between points smoothly by t*(len-1). Draw spark: bright head with shadowBlur, short trail of last ~8 points fading, plus small random jitter lines (electric). On arrival, flash the synapse (flash=1 decays), and 40% chance chain a new pulse from a random other synapse on the destination neuron's branches (random path activation). Also before synapses exist, allow pulses along random branches from root to tip.

Rendering: each frame: fill bg, radial glow gradient #101a3a center; subtle animated noise: ~150 random 1-2px dim rects; branches drawn as quadratic curves via midpoints, lineWidth width, strokeStyle branch/accent color, shadowBlur 8, globalAlpha 0.85, 'lighter' composite for glow; branch tips growing get small dot. Synapses: pulsing radius 2.5+sin, shadowBlur synapseGlow*(1+flash), color synapse, plus faint ring. Pulses. Then scanlines every 3px with rgba(0,229,255,0.08) at low alpha (draw cached via offscreen pattern canvas created in code – canvas only), slow moving scan bar. Vignette radial gradient transparent -> rgba(0,0,0,0.75). HUD text small monospace in #ffd400 top-left: "NEURONS n  BRANCHES n  SYNAPSES n  STATE growing/stable/paused".

Clear canvas: empties everything (neurons, branches, synapses, pulses) leaving background. Pause toggles animation updates (still render). requestAnimationFrame loop."}
